assessments.mechanism: Audit complete scientific artifacts—execution traces, code/data provenance, results and manuscript claims together rather than manuscript text alone.
assessments.clean_scope: Controlled scientist-agent audit evidence plus MLReplicate. Prior audit reports paper-only pitfall detection ~55% accuracy/~0.51 F1 versus ~82%/~0.81 with traces+code; MLReplicate AI-vs-human ratings Pearson r=0.29/Spearman rho=0.40 and fabricated/unsupported claims in 59% of automated acceptances. Strongest support is failure-detection need, not a proven online auditor.
assessments.uncertainty: Need randomized evidence that online full-artifact audit improves end-to-end discovery.
assessments.o_comparison: O records detailed events, binds artifacts/outcomes/source digests and treats final self-report/internal review as insufficient, but has not run paper-only versus trace+code detection or an online scientific-audit intervention.

assessments.mechanism: Parallel best-first/tree-based experimentation with checkpointed candidate branches rather than one-shot or purely sequential research.
assessments.clean_scope: AIRS-Bench/AI Scientist-v2 executable ML research. AIRS example normalized Greedy easy/medium/hard 0.73/0.48/0.30 vs One-Shot 0.10/0.18/0.05 and ReAct 0.50/0.31/0.15, but expert slice can favor ReAct and model/scaffold/budget are not fully matched.
assessments.uncertainty: Same-model budget-matched causal pairs remain needed; tree-search scaffold effects are not universal.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly knows AI Scientist-v2 and tested only a scoped adaptation: width-1 single-lineage versus width-3 sibling checkpoints on three frozen tasks. Width-3 raised median invocations 1.0→3.0 for only 0.827209s median wall-time improvement; that exact adaptation was rejected. This is not evidence against the original method, scientist-agent family, or untested tree mechanisms.

assessments.mechanism: Externalize scientific method selection into an explicit inspectable planning stage before execution.
assessments.clean_scope: ASI-Bench/ResearchClawBench diagnose method/protocol guidance bottlenecks but do not establish one universally effective planner implementation.
assessments.uncertainty: No direct O evaluation against those guidance-withdrawal conditions.
assessments.o_comparison: O already has inspectable Root/strategy selection of falsifiable units and method reconsideration under saturation; no dedicated scientific-method planner benchmark is implemented.

assessments.mechanism: Explicit research-procedure synthesis/protocol compilation: convert a chosen method into a complete executable procedure before experimentation.
assessments.clean_scope: ASI-Bench 2026 guidance gradient: full method+procedure B1 50.91 versus method-only/no detailed procedure B2 29.10 (-21.82), while removing method hint too gives B3 26.62 (only -2.48 more). B2 also uses ~6.91M tokens/49.7 min, ~59% more tokens/~32% more time than B1.
assessments.uncertainty: This diagnoses a bottleneck; optimal procedure compiler architecture and equal-budget intervention are unknown.
assessments.o_comparison: O has explicit Root→Execute planning, frozen semantic requests/manifests and inspectable procedures, so the planning/procedure-compilation principle is materially known; it has not tested a scientific protocol compiler against ASI-Bench guidance ablations.

assessments.mechanism: Verify plan/protocol→execution→evidence/claim consistency with bidirectional repair.
assessments.clean_scope: Failure-derived intervention hypothesis from scientist-agent analyses. ResearchClawBench/MLReplicate localize protocol/evidence mismatch and unsupported claims; no clean randomized online-verifier ablation is established.
assessments.uncertainty: Verifier placement, thresholds and repair policy require causal evaluation.
assessments.o_comparison: O binds requests/artifacts/outcomes/source digests/receipts and fails closed on mismatches, so a related provenance-consistency submechanism is implemented; no scientific protocol-to-paper consistency verifier/repair benchmark exists.

assessments.mechanism: Premise-validity/adversarial scientific-alignment gate before autonomous research invests in experiments/writing.
assessments.clean_scope: PseudoBench adversarial pseudoscience setting; demonstrates a failure mode rather than a validated mitigation.
assessments.uncertainty: No demonstrated premise-gate intervention in the clean source.
assessments.o_comparison: No dedicated premise-validity gate or PseudoBench-like resistance evaluation was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Relevant-reference retrieval plus bounded multi-agent refinement for research-idea construction.
assessments.clean_scope: ResearchAgent 2025. Full Problem/Method/Experiment 4.52/4.28/4.18 versus 4.20/4.03/3.92 without entities+references; removing references hurts more than entities; refinement saturates after ~3 iterations. Benefits depend on base model.
assessments.uncertainty: Idea-quality scores are not end-to-end executable/reproducible discovery evidence.
assessments.o_comparison: O revision-22 research intake explicitly requires traceable primary-source grounding and bounded high-information feed, so relevant-reference grounding is present; no bounded MAS idea-refinement mechanism/evaluation exists.

assessments.mechanism: Agentic self-challenging task/data generation with weak/strong discrimination and outer-loop meta-optimization.
assessments.clean_scope: Autodata synthetic-data/task-generation domain; transfer to end-to-end scientific method/experiment integrity is untested.
assessments.uncertainty: Exact marginal contribution of weak/strong discriminator/meta-loop is not an O result.
assessments.o_comparison: O has runtime-generated held-out tasks, self-improvement machinery and heterogeneous exploration, but no verified Autodata-style discriminator+prompt/meta-optimization loop; only adjacent components exist.

assessments.mechanism: Structured academic skill/tool packages as proposal-and-synthesis support while experiment reasoning remains a separate bottleneck.
assessments.clean_scope: ARAC-Bench 2026 matched ClaudeCode baseline 54.53; +AR-Skill 61.21 (+12.25%), +Arbor 59.16, +AIR-Skill 58.98, +SA-Skill 58.09. AR-Skill improves Related/Idea/Basic/Methodological strongly but Benchmark -6.28% and Coding -2.13%; authors report Proposal/Synthesis gains but not Experiment.
assessments.uncertainty: One benchmark/backend; component causality and replication across models/domains unresolved.
assessments.o_comparison: O has recursive Skill-in-Skill/context/tool modularization, but end-to-end semantic benefit is still under behavioral evaluation and no ARAC academic-skill package comparison exists.

assessments.mechanism: Dedicated iterative deep/wide scientific-literature discovery subsystem.
assessments.clean_scope: AutoResearchBench diagnoses literature-discovery difficulty but does not itself prove one high-performing search subsystem.
assessments.uncertainty: O has not evaluated a dedicated literature-search subsystem against that benchmark.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly directs heterogeneous external scientific search and recognizes literature comparison as necessary, so the high-level mechanism is known; no dedicated AutoResearchBench system exists.

assessments.mechanism: Abstract inspiration/cognitive-pivot signals that preserve a high-level clue while hiding the ground-truth solution, to trigger structured proposal reasoning.
assessments.clean_scope: ARAC-Bench 2026 proposal-stage ablation. Removing Inspiration while retaining domain background lowers average Idea 14.02→11.14 (-20.54%) across 11 systems; AutoResearchClaw -30.38% versus EvoScientist -11.58% in reported rows.
assessments.uncertainty: Benchmark supplies the clue; self-generation/selection of valid pivots without target leakage or misleading anchoring is unproven.
assessments.o_comparison: No explicit self-generated inspiration/pivot mechanism or matched proposal-stage ablation was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Tournament/debate/evolve hypothesis generation with scaled test-time compute.
assessments.clean_scope: AI co-scientist biomedical/hypothesis setting; Elo is self-evaluated and independent matched-budget causal isolation is missing.
assessments.uncertainty: No strong independent matched-budget attribution to tournament/debate/evolve components.
assessments.o_comparison: No tournament/debate/evolve hypothesis engine or matched-budget evaluation was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Programmatic claim provenance: data-chained manuscripts that backtrace narrative claims to analysis code and source data.
assessments.clean_scope: Data-to-paper 2025 biomedical data analysis/manuscript generation reports ~80-90% simple-goal/simple-dataset autonomous recapitulations without major errors and introduces programmatic claim backtracing; performance degrades with complexity/human copiloting.
assessments.uncertainty: Need evidence that provenance chains reduce hallucinated claims in open-ended agentic science; simple-task result is not broad discovery proof.
assessments.o_comparison: O already binds claims/evidence/artifacts/source receipts and preserves provenance across immutable work records, so a related provenance submechanism is implemented; no data-to-paper claim-chain efficacy evaluation exists.

assessments.mechanism: Evaluate workflow architecture independently from raw compute scaling; more tokens/cost alone is not a monotonic predictor of scientific quality.
assessments.clean_scope: MLReplicate/ASI-Bench 2026. Cheapest/fastest system reportedly beats most resource-intensive in human evaluation despite 38x input-token gap; ASI B3 examples GPT-5.6 xhigh ~40.86 at ~$684/run, Opus5+Claude Code ~40.70 at ~$2728, GPT-5.6 ultra 51.60 at ~$1550. Within a fixed strong configuration, xhigh→ultra still improves 40.86→51.60.
assessments.uncertainty: Cross-system comparisons confound model/workflow; this is boundary evidence against raw compute as universal predictor, not against within-workflow test-time scaling.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly optimizes expected elapsed time/information value and directly rejected one narrow width-scaling adaptation on invocations/time grounds, so compute-vs-architecture is partially tested. That result is not evidence against other scaling mechanisms or scientist-agent families.
